applies_to: the unchanged CRTR score producer across all declared risk policies and one-axis neighbors

score_boundary.hook_input: built-in dict[str,float] with sorted symbol insertion order and finite scores
score_boundary.timing: after every declared score transform and before score-span checks, asset selection, sleeve construction, or weighting
score_boundary.identity_requirement: The active Amendment 0005 hook must return the same keys and finite float values; strategy construction consumes the returned mapping
score_boundary.score_direction: higher score predicts higher simple executable-open-to-open return

label.name: manifest-horizon-simple-executable-open-to-open-return-v1
label.entry: organizer-authoritative executable open at decision_time; the price is never exposed to the strategy
label.exit: organizer-authoritative executable open at exactly decision_time + 72 hours
label.price_requirements: both opens must be finite and strictly positive
label.membership_requirements: symbol must be in the score map and executable at both endpoints
label.missing_rule: omit the symbol-boundary observation; never substitute, carry, fill, or shorten the horizon
label.fold_end_rule: purge the complete score decision when decision_time + 72 hours touches or crosses its frozen fold end
label.overlap_rule: labels are diagnostic only; compute each scheduled score boundary independently and do not use labels as strategy inputs

information_coefficient.unit: all valid decision-symbol pairs pooled globally and separately within each frozen fold
information_coefficient.paired_universe: all captured score rows with a valid exact-horizon label after fold-end purging
information_coefficient.statistic: Pearson correlation of raw captured scores and simple forward returns
information_coefficient.undefined_rule: report null globally or for a fold when fewer than 12 pairs remain or either centered vector has zero variance
information_coefficient.aggregation: report development pair count and Pearson plus pair count and Pearson for every frozen fold
information_coefficient.qualification_rule: declared-score diagnostic only; non-material, no trial-budget charge, and never an automatic qualification gate

canonical_score_payload.authority: team-local synthetic byte-invariance audit only; not an A5 evidence artifact or substitute for organizer capture
canonical_score_payload.invalid_record_rule: Any malformed nonempty PreconstructionScore map returns empty bytes; it must never be coerced or serialized as a valid-looking empty score artifact.
canonical_score_payload.byte_invariance: same causal input must be identical under future append/corruption/truncation, bar-map insertion order, and fresh construction

universe_rule: Use only A6-certified native crypto coins/tokens in DecisionContext.eligible_symbols; stablecoins, equities/TradFi, indexes, metals, commodities, and all other non-crypto contracts are forbidden even when listed as perpetuals.
registration_rule: Do not register or execute Team05 until the final executable-source manifest, independent semantic review, score manifest, material hashes, tests, and organizer registration are complete under the active A5/A6 authority.
